     8	/-!
     9	# The overlap component of finite-stage Picard base change
    10	
    11	The overlaps produced by `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` are nested pullbacks. We first
    12	flatten that categorical presentation, using the certified pullback presentation of
    13	the original overlap, and then apply the existing affine overlap comparison.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-- Flatten the nested pullback obtained by first base-changing `U` and then
    28	intersecting it with `V`. The only input about `W` is its displayed pullback
    29	presentation as `U ×_X V`. -/
    30	noncomputable def nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
    31	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    32	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    33	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    34	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    35	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    36	    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
    37	      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g := by
    38	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    39	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    40	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    41	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    42	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    43	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    44	  exact
    45	    asIso (pullback.map
    46	      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
    47	      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
    48	      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
    49	      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    50	    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    51	    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    52	    asIso (pullback.map
    53	      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
    54	      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g
    55	      e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
    56	      (by
    57	        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
    58	          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) e_inv_fst.symm)
    59	      (by simp))
    60	
    61	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    62	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    63	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    64	
    65	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    66	
    67	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    68	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    69	/-- The left overlap leg followed by the glued structure map is the affine
    70	structure morphism of the finite-stage overlap. -/
    71	theorem overlap_gluedMap
    72	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    73	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    74	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    75	    P.glueData.f U V ≫ P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
    76	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    77	        (algebraMap P.N.1
    78	          (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    79	            C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))) := by
    80	  rw [glueData_ι_gluedMap, glueData_f]
    81	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    82	  congr 1
    83	  ext x
    84	  exact (restrictionBaseChangeAlgHom C P U V).commutes x
    85

    87	-- The package projections retain dependent finite-subextension tensor instances.
    88	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    89	/-- The overlap component comparing `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` with the exact
    90	separably closed atlas. This is the component intended for the future
    91	`NatIso.ofComponents` comparing the two glue data. -/
    92	noncomputable def gluingOverlapBaseChangeIso
    93	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    94	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    95	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    96	    (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
    97	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).V (U, V) ≅
    98	      (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1.toScheme :=
    99	  nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
   100	      (P.glueData.ι U) (P.glueData.ι V) P.gluedMap
   101	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))
   102	      (P.glueData.f U V) (P.glueData.t U V ≫ P.glueData.f V U)
   103	      (by simp) (P.glueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit U V) ≪≫
   104	    pullback.congrHom (overlap_gluedMap C P U V) rfl ≪≫
   105	    overlapBaseChangeIso C P U V

    31	/-- A quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme has a finite affine open cover with
    32	quasi-compact pairwise intersections. -/
    33	theorem Scheme.exists_finite_affineCover_inter_isQuasiCompact (X : Scheme.{u})
    34	    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    35	    ∃ s : Set X.affineOpens, s.Finite ∧ (⨆ i ∈ s, (i : X.Opens)) = ⊤ ∧
    36	      ∀ U ∈ s, ∀ V ∈ s, IsCompact ((U : Set X) ∩ (V : Set X)) := by

    38	    (isCompact_iff_finite_and_eq_biUnion_affineOpens (U := (⊤ : X.Opens))).mp

    41	  intro U _ V _

    44	/-- A finite affine presentation of the intersection of two affine opens.  Besides
    45	covering the intersection exactly, it records finite presentation of both restriction
